answer: Replication cost books per seat, not per operator. One wallet registering 40 identities makes the 41st seat on that funding source cost 3.1 times the first, paid before the seat answers anything. Audit fees split across 5 auditors drawn from 3 unrelated subnetworks, so a farm that owns its own jury still pays the other two seats. A shared funding thread shows at registration. A terrace of cheap seats turns into a shale slope of prepaid fees, and the bill lands before the first payout.
